motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Bureau of Street Services, with the assistance of the Bureau of Engineering and any other necessary departments, be instructed and the Department of Recreation and Parks be requested to report with recommendations to develop the center medians along Broadway between 93rd Street and 112th Street as green and recreational spaces with benches, workout equipment, and a walking path to be managed and maintained by the Department of Recreation and Parks. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Administrative Officer, with the assistance of the Bureau of Street Services, the Department of Recreation and Parks, and any other necessary departments, be instructed to report with recommendations to fund the green and recreational improvements in the center medians along Broadway between 93rd Street and 112th Street. PRESENTED BY: MARQUEECE HARRIS-DAWSON Councilmember, 8th District SECONDED BY: M. AUG 2 5 2026 majs
